scope: All 36 learner/key masters, all original-to-current grammatical matrices, actual retained TeX cells/captions and bounded prose edits. PDF build and visual acceptance are separate gates.

inverse_master_baseline.method: Parsed every actual master independently, replaced each revised block by its recorded original and reversed exactly the declared 24 prose edits. All 36 normalized-LF whole-document hashes equal the baseline. This one-time proof used temporary access to the old prose; runtime binds the resulting approved current master and mapping hashes.

original_cell_mapping.method: Independent parser verifies every original header/body source coordinate occurs once in the map, every literal has an exact destination, and every displayed body cell has an origin. The semantic comparator expands shared persons and checks case, number, gender, person, tense, mood, lemma, strong/weak series and reference scope independently of the supplied coordinate map.

actual_tex_content.method: Independent decoder compares actual tabular/longtable cells with each logical matrix, checks physical-column coverage and exact captions, and finds every bounded prose replacement in retained TeX. Historical Unit1 vocabulary and Unit13 diagnostic reflows were reconstructed independently.
actual_tex_content.tex_identity_policy: Formatting-only TeX changes require a fresh run of scripts/check_course_layout.py. Current acceptance remains bound to the master and logical-mapping identities; recorded whole-TeX hashes identify this review snapshot.

canonical_semantics.method: 197 complete coverage fields and both cumulative register objects compared with baseline semantic hashes. Five source-span objects have explicitly bounded metadata changes: independent reversal restores each entire baseline object. The other 192 fields match directly. All 644 distinct Cook assignments, prompts, key item identities, paradigm objects, examples, outcomes and teaching records remain unchanged.

global_style_sweep.method: Scanned current matrices independently for unmerged identical three-person plurals and remaining aliases in complete finite, subjunctive, command and nominal systems. No unaddressed full-paradigm finding remains.
